value.rationale: Two hub vertices appear equally often in the network sequence and are identical in the aggregated graph, yet have provably distinct neutral invasion values for every finite phase duration. The all-size strict ordering, n^2 crossover for the second hub, and exact rational formulas clarify a meaningful time-ordering phenomenon and replace exponential absorbing-chain calculations for a natural graph family. The result supplies usable baselines for interpreting temporal selection effects and phase-of-introduction bias.
